name: BSP_LuaBinding_GenerateObject
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. lua_CFunction for the GenerateObject row of the mission binding table 00E0B7B8 (row at 00E0BFF8, name pointer 00D0FE00), exported by tools/lua_bindings_export.py into config/lua_bindings.json. Established as entity-returning mechanically: the body pushes the literal 00CE7494 ("thisTable") into 00B67910 BSP_LuaObject_GetByLiteral and reaches 00B663D0 BSP_LuaObject_PushValue, which is the nine-call tail read in full at 00898E30 BSP_LuaBinding_FindEntity (00898F98-00899045): decimal key from the u16 at entity+174h, thisTable[key], lua_pushvalue, return lua_gettop - frame base. The body itself was not read by this packet, so only the return convention is attributed, not the lookup. docs/LUA_BINDING_ENTITY.md. | Packet cc2_entity_lookup, read-only. It does create the entity it returns: 00945308 004C6BA0 -> 0046D930 (name, second name, 0) or 009452CA 004C6BE0 -> 0046DC10 (name, second name, Vector3*, yaw) on the scene database [00E18680]. 0046D930 resolves the name in the named-object map at sceneDb+18h (00468CD0, returns 0 when absent), the class token in the class map at sceneDb+34h (00468FB0), asks 0046C550 BSP_SceneEntity_ShouldGenerate and calls the descriptor's instantiate-pass creator at 0046DB4B, finishing with 00925F20. Arguments: 0 = the authored object's name, 1 = a second name when it is a string else a copy of argument 0, 1 or 2 = a table of three numbers (position, predicate 0088B840, reader 00888760), the next slot = a yaw in radians whose default 10.0f at 00CE38B8 is a sentinel above the 2*pi at 00CE3828 meaning no rotation. 00945311 00874D00 pumps the deferred queues, then the same thisTable tail as 00898E30 with no null check on the creator's result, and 009453BB 0046AAB0. docs/LUA_BINDING_GENERATE_OBJECT.md.

name: BSP_SpawnManager_RequeueRequest
evidence: Packet cc8_spawn_new_route. __thiscall(manager, &record), sole caller BSP_SpawnManager_DrainOneRequest at 0094C809 with ECX = EDI = the manager (the jump at 0094C5AD to 0094C802 bypasses both LEA EDI,[ESI+CCh] reassignments, checked by filtering the whole listing for EDI). The tail runs 00948793 STL, 0094879A CALL 00925F20 BSP_SEntity_InitAll, 009487A1, then 009487AD MOV byte ptr [EBX+C0h],1 - the fulfilled flag BSP_SpawnManager_DrainOneRequest reads at 0094C5A7. docs/LUA_SPAWN_NEW_HOST.md

name: BSP_SpawnManager_DrainOneRequest
evidence: Packet cc8_spawn_new_route. __fastcall(ECX = the manager at *(00F89B3C)); 0094C4AA MOV EDI,ECX. Reached from BSP_Game_OnMove step 20 through BSP_SpawnManager_TickThunk 0094C8F0 (CALL 0094C490 / RET 4); the scaled delta that thunk is passed is never read. Gates: 0094C4AE empty queue, 0094C4BC null DAT_00E188A8, 0094C4C4 game+1FE4h == 2. Rate limit 0094C4D1..0094C4F1: ST0 = config+2DCh + manager+0Ch over ST1 = DAT_00F876A4, FCOMIP then JA returns, so it proceeds only when now >= interval + lastAttempt. Selection 0094C4FA CMP EAX,1 / JBE 0094C56B takes the head for one record or none, otherwise 0094C508 walks for a record whose party (record+80h) indexes game+18CCh+party*4 with +8h != 0 and +9h == 0, falling back to the head. Then 0094C58E CALL 009439B0 erases it, 0094C59D stamps manager+0Ch, 0094C5A2 CALL 0094A140 solves and creates, and 0094C5A7 CMP byte [ESI+C0h],BL / 0094C5AD JZ 0094C802 branches: clear requeues through BSP_SpawnManager_RequeueRequest 009478B0, set runs the completion walk over record+CCh calling record+C4h(ECX = party, EDX = entity, stack = record+C8h) and then 00948BB0 and the free. docs/LUA_SPAWN_NEW_HOST.md
